items.title: UltraQuant on AMD Instinct: More Efficient Agentic Serving for Qwen3.8-MXFP4
items.summary: UltraQuant can raise decode throughput and cut latency under load without a measurable drop in reasoning accuracy. In this blog, we will show you how to bring that to long-context and agentic LLM serving on AMD Instinct GPUs with Qwen3.8-2.4T MXFP4. Once agent prompts reach hundreds of thousands of tokens, the key-value (KV) cache is the limiter and not compute. Multi-turn agents (long shared prefixes, short generations, high concurrency) hit this wall hardest.

items.summary: LLM agents automate GPU kernel optimization by repeatedly composing candidates and measuring their duration on real GPUs. However, this results in poor utilization because only a small fraction of command execution requires exclusive GPU access.
